maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from collector vehicle insurance premiums and commissions, plus memberships, marketplace and auctions; not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by private collectors and enthusiasts buying classic car insurance, memberships and auction services, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling more policies and memberships; Broad Arrow auctions and other acquisitions are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Policyholders can switch collector car insurers fairly easily at renewal, though agreed-value specialist coverage adds some stickiness.
